brand.name: Saydali+
brand.tagline: Iraq's relief network for pharmacies, pharmacists, and pharmacy students.
brand.positioning: A professional relief network — not gig work

auth.welcomeBack: Welcome back — enter your account details.

roles.pharmacistSub: Find relief shifts near you and get paid per shift.
roles.pharmacySub: Post shifts and internships, and find cover fast.
roles.studentSub: Find a pharmacy for your summer training.

fields.fullNameHint: As written on your Syndicate card
fields.pharmacyNameArHint: As written on your sign. Most pharmacists browse in Arabic.
fields.universityEmailHint: Must be your official university address. Personal Gmail or Yahoo addresses aren't accepted.
fields.uploadLicenceSub: Photo or scan of the licence document

errors.password: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.universityEmail: Enter your official university email — personal addresses aren't accepted.
errors.signInFailed: Could not sign in. Check your email and password.
errors.arabicRequired: Write the pharmacy name in Arabic script.

verification.pendingBody: Your details have been sent to the Syndicate of Iraqi Pharmacists for confirmation. This normally takes up to one week, and we'll email you as soon as it's done.
verification.banner: Your account is being verified. You can browse and apply now — your applications stay hidden from pharmacies until verification clears.
verification.bannerPharmacy: Your account is being verified. You can browse, but you can't post a shift until your licence is confirmed.

steps.createdSub: Your details and documents were received.

verification.queuedApplication: Your application will reach the pharmacy once your account is verified.
verification.manualNote: Iraq has no digital pharmacist registry, so a person on our side checks your document by hand.
verification.documentRequired: A reviewer cannot verify your account until you upload a photo of your document.

listings.openShifts: {count, plural, =0 {No open shifts} one {1 open shift} other {# open shifts}} near you
listings.openPlacements: {count, plural, =0 {No placements} one {1 placement} other {# placements}} open near you
listings.noneOpen: No open shifts in this district right now.

post.title: Post a shift
post.flatLine: Flat rate for the shift ({hours} hours) — works out at {implied} IQD/hour
post.notesPlaceholder: Anything they should know before accepting
post.internshipNote: Unpaid placement — a certificate of completion is provided to the student at the end, same as an in-person arrangement today.

fees.trialDaysLeft: {days} days left in your fee-free trial
fees.feeExplainer: {pharmacyPercent}% is added on top for the pharmacy, and {pharmacistPercent}% is deducted from the pharmacist's payout.
fees.floorNote: Minimum commission of {amount} IQD applies on short shifts, charged to the pharmacy. The pharmacist's {pharmacistPercent}% is unchanged.
fees.trialBothFree: You and the other account are both inside the free trial — no commission on either side.

applicants.title: Applicants
applicants.noRecordHint: A new account — no shifts completed through the platform yet.
applicants.acceptClosesListing: Accepting an applicant closes the listing and turns down the others.

handoff.title: Handoff checklist
handoff.intro: Worked through together at the start of the shift. Both parties confirming is what completes the booking, and it is what any later dispute is judged against.

items.controlled_register_counted: Controlled-substances register counted and signed by both parties
items.keys_alarm_safe_handed_over: Keys, alarm code and safe access handed over
items.owner_emergency_contact_confirmed: Emergency contact for the owner confirmed

handoff.waitingOther: Waiting for the other party to confirm
handoff.allItemsRequired: Agree all five items before confirming.
handoff.cannotUndo: A confirmation cannot be withdrawn once given.

bookings.cancelFree: Cancelling now will not affect your reliability record.
bookings.cancelLate: Cancelling now is late and counts against your reliability — there isn't time left for the pharmacy to find cover.
bookings.ratePlaceholder: An optional note for the other party

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.payoutNote: Funds reach your wallet within a few working days.
earnings.payoutFailed: The transfer did not complete. The request is saved and will be retried.
earnings.destinationHint: Your ZainCash or Qi Card number. It may differ from your account phone — a transfer to the wrong number cannot be recovered.
earnings.needsDestination: Add the wallet number to be paid into before requesting a payout.

logbook.title: Training logbook
logbook.whatYouLearned: What did you learn this week?
logbook.placeholder: Write what you learned and observed — at least 80 characters.
logbook.lockedNote: This week opens once you submit the previous one — the log fills forward.
logbook.needsAttendance: Record at least one day of attendance.
logbook.approveGate: A month can be approved once all four of its weeks are submitted.
logbook.noPlacement: No active placement yet. Browse the open placements and apply to one.
logbook.returnNeedsNote: Say why you are returning it (at least ten characters) so the student knows what to fix.
logbook.forwardFillNote: Each week opens once the previous one is submitted, and a month is approved once all four of its weeks are in.

certificate.title: Certificate of completion
certificate.locked: Your certificate unlocks once the pharmacy has approved all three months of your logbook.
certificate.limitNote: This is the platform's record of what was verified. The credential your university requires remains the pharmacy's own letter or stamp — we solve the matching and the record-keeping, and are not a credentialing authority.

cv.title: My CV
cv.verifiedNote: These figures are computed from your shifts and ratings on the platform and cannot be edited — which is precisely what makes them worth something to an employer.
cv.cvLanguageNote: Your CV's language is independent of the app's language.

ai.noInvention: The assistant only reworks what you wrote. It never adds employers, dates, duties or qualifications — your CV is backed by Syndicate verification, and anything invented works against you.
ai.failed: That didn't complete. Your CV is unchanged.
ai.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
ai.title: Writing assistant
ai.nothingToWorkOn: Write a summary or an experience entry first, so there is something to rework.
ai.applyStillNeedsSave: Apply only updates the form — save to keep the change.

cv.otherLangExists: You also have a version of your CV in the other language.

incidents.evidenceGate: A report can only be filed about a shift where both parties completed the handoff checklist.
incidents.descriptionHint: Explain in detail — at least 50 characters.
incidents.tier1Note: Every report starts as an internal flag. The other party is asked for their account, and nothing leaves the platform at this stage.
incidents.rightOfReply: You have a right of reply
incidents.title: Reports
incidents.filedNote: The other party will be asked for their account. Nothing leaves the platform at this stage.
incidents.noEvidenceYet: This shift cannot be reported: the handoff checklist was never completed by both parties.
incidents.replyPlaceholder: Give your account of what is alleged.
incidents.replyTooShort: Write a proper account (at least twenty characters).

admin.reviewNote: Check the document against Syndicate records before verifying. There is no automated check.
admin.noDocument: No document uploaded yet — there is nothing to verify against.

common.somethingWentWrong: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved.
common.exportFellBack: Direct download was unavailable — the print dialog was used instead.

upload.tooLarge: That file is over 10 MB. Try a smaller photo.
upload.failed: The upload did not complete. Try again.
upload.afterSignup: You can upload the document once your account is created.

notifications.newApplicant: A pharmacist applied to your listing
notifications.monthReady: A month of logs is waiting for your approval
notifications.monthApproved: The pharmacy approved a month of your logbook
notifications.placementConfirmed: You were accepted for the placement
notifications.incidentFiled: A report naming you was filed — you have a right of reply

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: You are offline. We don't show you saved shifts, because they may already have been filled — try again when you are back on the network.
